reference_basis: Andani et al. 2025 V0.8.2 FINAL_VALIDATED2 + V0.8.3 delegated terminology interaction fix
required_interactions: sentence-level English-Chinese pairing and paired highlighting
inline citation popup at citation position
inline figure/table reference opens the corresponding asset
highlighted terminology opens explanation on click, Enter, or Space
terminology interaction works in the bilingual body, right viewer, and dynamically rendered figure-study document
complete figure/table preview index including supplementary figures and tables referenced by the article
full-screen figure-study with the actual source image and panel-by-panel explanations
reference popups, annotation tools, reader settings, resizing and viewer controls

supplementary_source_contract.rule: If the article cites supplementary figures or tables that are not embedded in the supplied main PDF, the generator must independently retrieve the official supplementary information before declaring the reader complete.
preferred_sources: PubMed Central / Europe PMC supplementary files
author-provided official repository or archival deposit
requirements: use the actual supplementary figure/table rather than reconstructing it from prose
verify the final-publication numbering against the publisher version
read the official caption and visually inspect every panel before writing panel explanations
make supplementary figure/table references clickable at their original sentence positions
include supplementary assets in the preview index and figure-study mode
record source provenance and file checksum
not_allowed: omit a supplementary figure only because it is absent from the user-supplied main PDF
substitute an older preprint supplement when final publisher supplementary material is available
invent a supplementary figure from the main-text description

forbidden_regressions: paragraph-level matching in place of sentence-level pairing
figure references moved to paragraph ends
generic figure explanation without panel-by-panel coverage
supplementary figures referenced in the paper but absent from the final reader without an explicit source-unavailability audit
paper-specific HTML/CSS/JS generated independently instead of using the fixed reader shell
